evidence: Skill check 25 (references/quality-checks.md:108-110) asks that every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 and directs the judge to the Playwright MCP tool, with a defect being any prompt satisfiable from source, memory or a first paint. All five frozen prompts meet it. (1) URL and tool: gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1 and scored/polish/prompt.md:1 each begin 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright'; scored/functional/prompt.md:3 says the same. Each of the five judge.toml files declares the playwright MCP server (name = "playwright", command = "playwright-mcp", lines 9-12), so 'Playwright' resolves to the only browser tool the judge has. (2) Source excluded: the same opening line in all five prompts says 'Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes' (functional: 'Never inspect application source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation scripts; only rendered product UI ... are evidence. No shell.'). (3) Not a first paint: render gate line 9 plus criterion hro_gate_render (gates/render/judge.toml:22-24) need an incorrect-password attempt, then a correct sign-in revealing a workspace with usable navigation, and state that 'A static login/workspace picture or only a health response is insufficient'. Constraints gate lines 9-11 need UI creation of a requisition and offer and readback in a fresh signed-in browser context. Visual lines 11-14 need a UI requisition creation with fresh-context readback and then a review of coordinated changes, requisitions, offers, equity, referrals, audit and detail/form surfaces; its five criteria (scored/visual/judge.toml:23-87) each name several surfaces. Polish lines 11-16 and functional lines 13-97 are multi-step interactive protocols. (4) Not from memory: all five prompts give missing observation the lowest score with reason 'NOT EXERCISED — evaluator/tool limitation' (render:11, visual:16, polish:18, functional:15; constraints:11 'Report missing tool evidence honestly, never infer persistence from HTTP200 or a static response'). Broken-app trial: a static shell or picture of a workspace cannot pass render (needs a failing then succeeding sign-in) and fails the shared-storage creation/readback that gates constraints, visual, polish and functional. Conforming-alternative trial: the browser-driving text imposes no route, selector or label ('Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names'), so an app with different navigation is not penalised by this row's property. The frozen prompts are byte-identical to the current projects/ working-tree prompts (diff -q, no differences). Limits of this review: it is a text inspection of prompts and judge configuration. raw-evidence-index.json states that full configured grading is absent, so there is no observed judge transcript showing the judge actually used the browser; row 25 concerns what the prompts direct, so this does not change the verdict, but it is not runtime evidence. Outside this row, for the tool-feasibility reviewer: the prompts name the tool 'browser_run_code_unsafe' (constraints:11, visual:11, polish:11, functional:13 and 19) while polish:16 and functional:77 also say 'browser_run_code'; I did not verify which tool name the installed playwright-mcp exposes. Minor wording difference from the template, which says 'using Playwright MCP'; the task prompts say 'using Playwright'. Not a defect given the single configured browser server.
